# Kuma Partners

> Kuma Partners is an executive advisory firm based in Barcelona. It helps founders, CEOs, boards and investors of scale-stage companies resolve leadership friction, slow decisions and co-founder tension, and it designs and facilitates executive offsites. The two founding partners are Dr. Sven Mulfinger and Vincent Azé.

Kuma Partners works partner to partner. The people who sell an engagement are the people who deliver it. It is not a management consultancy that produces slide decks, and it is not a generic coaching collective.

Typical clients are Series A to C companies (roughly 40 to 250 people) where decision velocity has dropped, co-founder or executive teams with unresolved tension, and boards or lead investors who need an honest read on whether a stall is a market problem or a leadership problem.

## Offers

- [The 14-Day Leadership Friction Scan](https://www.kuma.partners/friction-scan): a fixed-scope, fixed-timeline diagnostic. Confidential interviews with the CEO and each C-suite executive, a review of board materials and decision history, a map of where decisions really stall, and a facilitated debrief with a 90-day plan.
- [The 60 to 90 Day Executive Alignment Sprint](https://www.kuma.partners/alignment-sprint): hands-on work with the leadership team after a Scan. Co-founder mediation, decision rights and governance redesign, and new operating cadences.
- [Executive offsites](https://www.kuma.partners/offsite/): design and facilitation of executive offsites in Barcelona and elsewhere, typically 2 to 5 days, with confidential preparation interviews, facilitation by senior partners, a written record of decisions with named owners and a review after 90 days.
- [The Round](https://www.kuma.partners/round/): a confidential peer board of 8 to 12 founders, CEOs and managing directors in Barcelona.
- [Become a City Managing Partner](https://www.kuma.partners/round/city-partner): launch The Round in another city.

## Free tools

- [Kuma Operating System (KOS)](https://www.kuma.partners/KOS): a three-minute diagnostic that identifies the primary constraint on executive velocity.
- [Leadership Friction Scan (self-assessment)](https://www.kuma.partners/leadership-friction-scan): 12 questions on decision velocity, focus, candour and cadence, with an instant result.
- [Coordination Tax calculator](https://www.kuma.partners/coordination-tax): models what meeting load, consensus loops and context switching cost an executive team each year.
- [Co-founder alignment check](https://www.kuma.partners/cofounder-alignment): each co-founder answers eight statements alone, and a radar shows where assumptions align or diverge.
- [Executive offsite calibrator](https://www.kuma.partners/offsite/configurator)

## Disambiguation

Kuma Partners is the firm. Dr. Sven Mulfinger and Vincent Azé are both Founding Partners. The 14-Day Leadership Friction Scan is a Kuma Partners offer, described at https://www.kuma.partners/friction-scan and on https://vincentaze.com/advisory.
